What if you brushed your teeth really hard every day?
Hard bristle toothbrushes are still sold in lots of stores. It feels extra clean. Many people think more pressure means cleaner teeth.

But here's the twist. Scrubbing hard can wear away enamel and push your gums back, so dentists say use a soft brush and gentle little circles! Two minutes, twice a day, with gentle pressure, is all you need.
